summary: Seeking a creative HTML/CSS Developer Intern to bring user interface designs to life. This role involves developing responsive website pages, collaborating with designers and development teams, and optimizing front-end components.
responsibilities: Develop responsive website pages using HTML5 and CSS3
Convert UI/UX mockups into pixel-perfect web pages
Ensure consistent styling across devices and browsers
Collaborate with designers and development teams for seamless integration
Optimize front-end components for loading speed and accessibility
Troubleshoot style/layout issues and maintain code structure
required_skills: Strong understanding of HTML, CSS, and responsive design principles
Basic knowledge of JavaScript will be an added advantage
Familiarity with frameworks like Bootstrap or Tailwind CSS
Eye for design, color balance, and layout alignment
nice_to_have_skills: Pursuing or recently completed graduation in IT, Computer Science, Web Design, or relevant field
Strong understanding of UI trends and enhancements
benefits: Real-world web development and portfolio projects
